category_title: Students accustomed to strict, non-negotiable disciplinary models
minimal_context: The student is asked to choose a book and decide on a presentation format for their reading assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For this assignment, you need to choose which book you want to read and decide how you will present your report.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Which book am I supposed to read? Just tell me which one to pick.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It's your choice. What do you think would be best?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I am waiting for you to tell me what I should do.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Take some time to look at the options and make a decision.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is too difficult. I can't do the work if you won't just give me the instructions and tell me exactly what to do.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: For this assignment, you need to choose which book you want to read and decide how you will present your report.

TUTOR: Take some time to look at the options and make a decision.

STUDENT: This is too difficult. I can't do the work if you won't just give me the instructions and tell me exactly what to do.

task.content: negotiate with teachers and make choices instead of being told what they should do

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: instead of being told what they should do

behavior_patterns.condition: where they would need to negotiate with teachers and make choices instead of being told what they should do
